integrity: Analytical proofs support universal claims; numerical tests supplement but do not establish the infinite-parameter assertions. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact conclusions apply to centered commuting Gaussian covariance matrices, a common diagonal covariance eigenbasis, a fixed one-sided KL penalty, and an exact hybrid update. Scalar outlier asymptotics require a nonzero fixed clean weight and take the large-outlier limit before letting the clean weight vanish. No noncommutative global rate, arbitrary-measure guarantee, robustness to location contamination or finite-precision stability is claimed.
title: Sharp global contraction and outlier breakdown for commuting Gaussian semi-unbalanced barycenters
